tasks.gr8-listening-speaking-t2: Topic: Listening and Speaking (Grade 8 Term 2). Cover oral presentations, interviews, everyday transactions, and summarising spoken texts. Ask learners to select suitable presentation choices, respond to interview prompts, identify details from spoken scenarios, and choose accurate oral summaries.
tasks.gr8-reading-viewing-t2: Topic: Reading and Viewing (Grade 8 Term 2). Cover folklore, youth prose, media texts, comprehension, theme, and character. Ask learners to identify theme and character evidence, interpret media-text purpose, retrieve key details, and make supported inferences from prose extracts.
tasks.gr8-writing-presenting-t2: Topic: Writing and Presenting (Grade 8 Term 2). Cover email writing, reviews, reports, informal paragraphs, and process writing. Ask learners to choose correct text conventions, sequence ideas clearly, match tone to audience and purpose, and improve drafts using editing decisions.
tasks.gr8-language-structures-t2: Topic: Language Structures (Grade 8 Term 2). Cover pronouns, direct and indirect speech, question forms, conjunctions, and concord. Ask learners to transform short sentences, choose accurate linking words, identify correct pronoun and concord usage, and complete language-in-context items.
